message:
Merge pull request #33 from crash7/go-report-card

Add Go Report Card badge and fix spelling error

pr.title: Add Go Report Card badge and fix spelling error
pr.body:
First of all, thanks for porting the library, really useful.

This is just a small contribution, I saw that there was a small spelling error that was preventing this to get the 100% in all the tests of https://goreportcard.com/report/github.com/joho/godotenv, so this is the fix for that. In addition I added the report card badge to the readme.

Hope this is useful in some way, just wanted to give something back to the project.

explanation.what: README に Go Report Card のバッジを追加し、godotenv.go のパッケージコメント内のタイポ「avaiable」を「available」に修正した。
explanation.why: PR body の通り、投稿者が goreportcard.com でこのリポジトリのスコアを見た際にスペルミスが100%評価を妨げていることに気づき、その修正とあわせてスコアバッジを README に追加する小さな貢献として送られたPR。

highlights.note: パッケージコメントのタイポ修正(avaiable → available)
